headline: Google publishes a container escape for an nf_tables flaw fixed in February
deck: CVE-2026-23111, rated 7.8, needs only CAP_NET_ADMIN, which unprivileged user namespaces hand to ordinary users on many nodes. Fixed kernels: 5.15.200, 6.1.163, 6.6.124, 6.12.70, 6.18.10.

deck: HashiCorp published five Consul bulletins on October 26. Move consul-k8s to 2.1.0 or 1.8.18, and Consul to 2.1.0 or Enterprise 1.21.19.

deck: CVE-2026-99999, called PwnEscape, went public on October 19. Every kernel from 2.6.27 is affected and there is no workaround.
